# Aggregated opinions of external experts about Mr. Wolf

Structure: one subfolder per review wave / dialogue, named `YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>/`.

- `2026-07-03-concept-review/` — first wave of expert reviews of the project concept (deepseek, gemeni [empty placeholder], kimi, openai, qwen, zai). Digest of this wave: `docs/archive/external-experts-review-aggregate-2026-07-03.md`.
- `2026-08-31-self-learning-research/` — dialogue with external expert on self-learning research (2026-08-31).

Folder is tracked in git (35 files under `reviews/`); texts are stored verbatim, not reformatted — see `../README.md`.
